  "file_path": "/mnt/c/Users/cabot/OneDrive/Documents/Research/Cambridge/X3I/mhd_llm/claude/ref/ccmc/README.md",
  "content": "# CCMC ENLIL run Jan_Deca_120925_SH_1: retrieved products

Run page: https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/ror/results/viewrun.php?runnumber=Jan_Deca_120925_SH_1

ENLIL 2.8f-beta, WSA 5.4 / GONGZ time-dependent inner boundary (0.1 AU), 64 cone CMEs (DONKI 2025-09-01 to 2025-12-09), grid 576x24x90 (r 0.1–3.1 AU uniform, colatitude 42–138°, longitude 0–360°), HEEQ+180 frame, synodic boundary rotation, gamma 5/3, ambient setting a6b1. Run date (t = 0) is 2025-10-01T00:00:00 UTC; relaxation from t = -720 h; stop at t = +1656 h (2025-12-09T00). `nblk=2`: block 1 is the CME run and block 2 is the ambient (no-CME) run computed alongside it. Block 1 carries a nonzero cloud tracer DP and block 2 has DP = 0 everywhere. The CCMC text files contain block 1 only.

## How the data were obtained

All files come from the RoR file API `https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/ror/api/get_run_file.php?runnumber=Jan_Deca_120925_SH_1&filename=<name>` (plain GET with a browser User-Agent). The full listing, with sizes and a `downloadable` flag, is at `https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/ror/results/run_files.php?runnumber=Jan_Deca_120925_SH_1&format=json` (also `&format=txt`). Copies are saved as `raw/run_files.json`, `raw/run_files.txt` and `raw/run_files.html`. The server often returns `500 Proxy Error / SSL Handshake` (about 270 bytes). `scripts/fetch.py` and `scripts/getfiles.py` retry up to 10–12 times with 5–20 s random backoff, and each download is checked against the size in the listing.

- Virtual-spacecraft netCDF, which holds both blocks: `filename=evo.<body>.nc` (4.05 MB each). The copies under `CME_estimates/2AU/evo.<body>.nc` are byte-identical (checked for 3I-Atlas and earth).
- CCMC 1D text, block 1 only: `filename=ENLIL_at_<body>.txt` (6.8 MB each). These files do not appear in run_files.json, but the API serves them. They are the files behind the "View ENLIL at ..." links.
- 3D time slices: `filename=tim.NNNN.nc` (99.5 MB each, NNNN = 0000–0276, 6-hour cadence, t ≈ 6·NNNN h after 2025-10-01T00).
- Grid: `filename=grd.nc`. Metadata: `filename=ror_metadata.json`.
- Bodies: 3I-Atlas, earth, stereoa, solo, mars, parkersp, psyche, juice, venus, mercury.

Requests that did not work:
- 1D-viewer POST to `/cgi-bin/visualizers/idl1d/run_idl1d.cgi?dir=47767&file=ENLIL_at_3I-Atlas.txt`, with the full form (Quantity 9/3/10 = N/V_r/T, Output_Pointdata=1). It returns a page with no plot and a `/idl_images/pointdata_<id>.txt` link marked "0.00 KB", and that link returns 500. The IDL backend appears to be broken. The request is in `scripts/idl1d_post.py` and the response in `raw/post_3i_NVT.html`.
- Direct path `/RoR_WWW/SH/ENLIL/2025/Jan_Deca_120925_SH_1/ENLIL_at_3I-Atlas.txt` returns 404.
- `bnd.nc` (1.15 GB) is flagged `downloadable: false` and was not fetched.
- `fld.<body>.nc` (149 MB each) were not fetched and their contents were not inspected.

## Files

```
raw/nc/evo.<body>.nc                 native ENLIL evolution files (all 10 bodies), grd.nc, ror_metadata.json
raw/nc/CME_estimates__2AU__evo.{3I-Atlas,earth}.nc   duplicates (identical)
raw/txt/ENLIL_at_<body>.txt          CCMC 1D text files (all 10 bodies)
raw/tim/tim.NNNN.nc                  3D slices 0220 0240 0252 0253 0254 0255 0256 0257 0258
raw/tim/check_tim_vs_evo.json        3D-slice validation (below)
timeseries/enlil_<body>.csv          CME run (block 1), tidy
timeseries/enlil_<body>_ambient.csv  ambient run (block 2), tidy
timeseries/crosscheck_vs_ccmc_txt.json   max relative difference between the CSVs and the CCMC text files
timeseries/summary_windows.json      medians, minima and maxima in the XMM window (3I) and Nov 20–Dec 5 (earth, stereoa)
quicklook/                           CCMC quick-look PNG frames and animations (below)
qc_enlil_3i.png qc_enlil_earth.png qc_enlil_stereoa.png
scripts/                             fetch.py getfiles.py idl1d_post.py build_csv.py check_tim.py qc_plot.py summary.py
```

Rebuild with `python3 -I scripts/build_csv.py <ccmc dir>`, then `qc_plot.py`, `summary.py` and `check_tim.py` with the same argument.

## evo.<body>.nc (netCDF-3 classic, readable with scipy.io.netcdf_file)

Dimensions: `nevo` = 38925 numerical steps, written every step (cadence 3.7–5.8 min), from t = -30 d (relaxation) to +69.0006 d; `nblk` = 2. The variables, in SI units, are:

| var | dims | units | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| TIME | nevo | s | physical time since 2025-10-01T00:00:00 UTC |
| X1, X2, X3 | nevo | m, rad, rad | body position: r, colatitude θ, longitude φ (HEEQ+180) |
| D | nevo,nblk | kg m^-3 | mass density |
| T | nevo,nblk | K | temperature |
| V1, V2, V3 | nevo,nblk | m s^-1 | V_r, V_θ (positive southward), V_φ |
| B1, B2, B3 | nevo,nblk | T | B_r, B_θ, B_φ with the polarity removed (unipolar), see below |
| DP | nevo,nblk | – | CME cloud tracer |
| BP | nevo,nblk | – | magnetic polarity tracer |

The physical field is B = sign(BP)·(B1, B2, B3). This reproduces the CCMC text B_r and B_lon to within 5e-6 relative.

## Tidy CSV columns (timeseries/enlil_<body>[_ambient].csv)

Rows have t ≥ 0 only (27499 rows, 2025-10-01T00:00:41 to 2025-12-09T00:00:52), at native ENLIL step cadence.

| column | units | definition |
|---|---|---|
| utc | ISO 8601 UTC | 2025-10-01T00:00:00 + TIME (rounded to 1 s) |
| t_day | d | TIME/86400 (the 1D viewer "Time0/Time1" axis) |
| r_au | AU | X1 / 1.495978707e11 |
| lat_deg | deg | 90° − θ: HEEQ latitude, i.e., heliographic latitude relative to the solar equator, positive north |
| lon_deg | deg | φ in HEEQ+180: Earth sits at 180° |
| lon_heeq_deg | deg | HEEQ longitude in (−180, 180], = lon_deg − 180 |
| vr_kms, vlon_kms, vlat_kms | km s^-1 | V1, V3, −V2 (vlat positive northward) |
| n_cm3 | cm^-3 | D / 1.67239e-27 kg / 1e6 (CCMC's own conversion, verified against the text N to 5e-6) |
| T_K | K | T |
| br_nT, blon_nT, blat_nT | nT | s·B1, s·B3, −s·B2, with s = sign(BP) (blat positive northward) |
| dp | – | cloud tracer (block 1; ≈0 means no CME material) |
| bp | – | polarity tracer |
| nvr_cm2s | cm^-2 s^-1 | n_cm3 · vr_kms · 1e5 |

Cross-check against the CCMC text files (block 1): t, R, Lat, Lon, V_r, V_lon, V_lat, B_r, B_lon, N and T all agree within 5e-6 relative (float formatting). R differs by 1.8e-5 because CCMC uses AU = 1.496e11 m. See `timeseries/crosscheck_vs_ccmc_txt.json`.

Quirks of the CCMC text files (`raw/txt/ENLIL_at_<body>.txt`):
- Line 1 lists `E_r E_lat E_lon`, but the real column order is the one in the `#` header on line 8: `E_r E_lon E_lat`, verified from −V×B.
- The B_lat column is +s·B_θ, which is positive southward, so it is not sign-flipped. V_lat is flipped (= −V_θ), in line with the file's own note. CCMC's E fields are nevertheless computed as if B_lat were northward. The CSVs use blat_nT = −s·B_θ (northward), so `blat_nT = −(CCMC B_lat)` exactly.
- The trailing BP column (±1) differs from sign(BP) of the evo file in about 40% of rows and was not used.
- Units in the header: Time [day since 2025-10-01T00 UTC], R [AU], Lat/Lon [deg, HEEQ+180], V [km/s], B [nT], N [cm^-3], T [K], E [mV/m], P_ram [nPa].

## 3D time slices (raw/tim/tim.NNNN.nc)

netCDF-3 files with dimensions n1 = 576 (r), n2 = 24 (θ), n3 = 90 (φ) and nblk = 2. Variables D T V1 V2 V3 B1 B2 B3 DP BP have shape (nblk, n3, n2, n1), with the same units and polarity convention as the evo files. X1(nblk,n1) [m], X2(nblk,n2) [rad, colatitude] and X3(nblk,n3) [rad, HEEQ+180] are cell centers, and TIME is a scalar [s]. Each file holds both the CME and the ambient block. The grid is also in raw/nc/grd.nc, with interface positions X1H/X2H/X3H.

| file | UTC |
|---|---|
| tim.0220.nc | 2025-11-25T00:03:40 |
| tim.0240.nc | 2025-11-30T00:02:11 |
| tim.0252.nc | 2025-12-03T00:01:13 |
| tim.0253.nc | 2025-12-03T06:03:14 |
| tim.0254.nc | 2025-12-03T12:01:24 |
| tim.0255.nc | 2025-12-03T18:03:33 |
| tim.0256.nc | 2025-12-04T00:01:01 |
| tim.0257.nc | 2025-12-04T06:03:00 |
| tim.0258.nc | 2025-12-04T12:01:02 |

To validate the slices, `scripts/check_tim.py` interpolates trilinearly (with periodic φ) at the evo position of 3I-Atlas, Earth and STEREO-A. Density matches evo to 4 digits, and V_r and T match to <0.3% (T at Earth up to 2%). This confirms the array order (φ, θ, r) and the HEEQ+180 longitude. Sampling 3I at φ+180° gives very different values, e.g., n = 0.39 instead of 1.21 at 12-03T12.

## Quick-look graphics (quicklook/)

Directory separators in CCMC file names are replaced by `__`.
- Frames at 2025-11-25T00, 11-30T00, 12-03T12, 12-04T00 and 12-04T06 for den1, vel1, den2e1, vel2e1, den3, vel3, den3e1 and vel3e1 (earth), and den3e1 and vel3e1 (stereoa).
- Timeline plots for every body: evo10o1-<body> and evo4o1-<body>. Also evo1o4-den, evo1o4-vel, the jmap2 J-maps, and the CME_estimates/2AU arrival-time timelines and .dat files.
- Animations gifs/den3-earth_low3syn_anim.gif and gifs/vel3-earth_low3syn_anim.gif.
- The remaining animations (about 2.4 GB in total) and the 277-frame sequences are listed in raw/run_files.json and can be fetched with `scripts/getfiles.py raw/run_files.json quicklook <name> ...`.
